speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
text: The Government has also introduced Cost-of-Living (COL) measures to help Singaporean households cope with their living expenses.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
text: These will help to defray a wide range of household expenses for families with children.

speaker: Mr Speaker
